targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, series, sum(cnt) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'DEFINE-61' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_61 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'DELETE-65' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_65 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'ALTER-66' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_66 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date),' ',if(time='','00:00:00',time)))) AS hour, 'SCRATCH-17' AS series, count() AS cnt FROM smf.smf_17 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date) GROUP BY hour
) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT action, sum(c) AS events FROM (
  SELECT 'DEFINE' AS action, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_61 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'DELETE' AS action, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_65 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ALTER' AS action, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_66 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'SCRATCH' AS action, count() AS c FROM smf.smf_17 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
) GROUP BY action ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT action, entry_name AS dsname, job_name, count() AS rows FROM (
  SELECT 'DEFINE' AS action, entry_name, job_name FROM smf.smf_61 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'DELETE' AS action, entry_name, job_name FROM smf.smf_65 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ALTER' AS action, entry_name, job_name FROM smf.smf_66 WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
) WHERE entry_name!='' GROUP BY action, dsname, job_name ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 60
